task_metadata.research_topic: UNet backbone and attention placement design for unconditional CIFAR-10 diffusion models
task_metadata.research_question: What UNet architecture achieves the best FID on unconditional CIFAR-10 diffusion, given a fixed training procedure with epsilon prediction, DDIM sampling, and a fixed optimizer/schedule?
notes: The repo baselines `full-attn` and `no-attn` are local architectural ablations rather than named methods from standalone papers, so they are linked approximately to the closest literature.

The task description says 35,000 training steps per scale, but the checked scripts currently set `MAX_STEPS=10000` for `train_small`, `MAX_STEPS=1000` for `train_medium`, and `MAX_STEPS=35000` for `train_large`.

tests.label: train_small
tests.notes: Small-scale unconditional CIFAR-10 diffusion run using the DDPM training setup, 50-step DDIM sampling, and clean-fid-style FID evaluation.

tests.label: train_medium
tests.notes: Medium-scale unconditional CIFAR-10 diffusion run using the DDPM training setup, 50-step DDIM sampling, and clean-fid-style FID evaluation.

tests.label: train_large
tests.notes: Large-scale unconditional CIFAR-10 diffusion run using the DDPM training setup, 50-step DDIM sampling, and clean-fid-style FID evaluation.

baselines.name: standard
baselines.notes: Maps directly to the Ho et al. DDPM CIFAR-10 UNet described in the task and baseline edit.

baselines.name: full-attn
baselines.notes: This exact all-resolution attention CIFAR-10 baseline is a repo ablation, not a standalone named method; linked approximately to diffusion papers that study attention-heavy backbones and the core self-attention paper.

baselines.name: no-attn
baselines.notes: This exact no-per-resolution-attention DDPM variant is a local ablation; linked approximately to the convolutional U-Net backbone and the original DDPM formulation it modifies.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Primary paper for the task's standard baseline and overall DDPM CIFAR-10 training setup.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.relevance: The task evaluates models with fixed 50-step DDIM sampling, so this paper grounds the sampling procedure used by every test.

papers.title: Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images
papers.relevance: Provides a DOI-backed citation record for the CIFAR-10 dataset used by every task test.

papers.title: GANs Trained by a Two Time-Scale Update Rule Converge to a Local Nash Equilibrium
papers.relevance: Introduces FID, the metric the task optimizes and reports.

papers.title: On Aliased Resizing and Surprising Subtleties in GAN Evaluation
papers.relevance: Motivates the clean-fid evaluation protocol explicitly used in the task implementation.

papers.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
papers.bibtex: @inbook{Ronneberger_2015, title={U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation}, ISBN={9783319245744}, ISSN={1611-3349}, url={http://dx.doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-24574-4_28}, DOI={10.1007/978-3-319-24574-4_28}, booktitle={Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention – MICCAI 2015}, publisher={Springer International Publishing}, author={Ronneberger, Olaf and Fischer, Philipp and Brox, Thomas}, year={2015}, pages={234–241} }
papers.relevance: Canonical U-Net backbone reference for the convolutional design space explored by the task and the no-attention ablation.

papers.title: Improved Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.relevance: Relevant follow-up diffusion paper on architectural and training refinements that informs the broader design space around the task.

papers.title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
papers.relevance: Contains influential diffusion architecture ablations and is the closest literature match for the task's full-attention baseline.

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.relevance: Places DDPM-style image generation in the broader score-based framework and reports strong CIFAR-10 results with architectural improvements.

papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models
papers.relevance: Directly relevant design-space paper on how architectural and sampler choices affect diffusion performance, including CIFAR-10.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.relevance: Foundational self-attention reference for the task's explicit attention-placement design space.

papers.title: All are Worth Words: A ViT Backbone for Diffusion Models
papers.relevance: Relevant alternative diffusion backbone paper showing how transformer-style architectures can replace the standard convolutional U-Net.

papers.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
papers.relevance: Another strong architecture paper relevant to this task's invitation to replace the default U-Net with a custom backbone.
